description: Source code for managing file transfers (upload/download) in a TR-069 management system, including transfer initiation, status updates, timeout handling, and initialization at startup.

methods.name: DM_ENG_Device_new_dm_entry
methods.description: Creates a new transfer entry in the data model.

methods.name: DM_ENG_Device_UpdateTransferState
methods.description: Updates the transfer status, fault code, and completion time.

methods.name: DM_ENG_Device_BuildTransferCompleteResponse
methods.description: Builds a transfer complete response structure from transfer data.

methods.name: DM_ENG_Device_TransferCompleteEvent
methods.description: Handles transfer completion event, sends notification, and cleans up subscription.

methods.name: DM_ENG_Device_TransferTimedOut
methods.description: Handles transfer timeout, updates state, and triggers transfer complete event.

methods.name: DM_ENG_Device_AddTransferSubscription
methods.description: Adds a subscription for transfer events.

methods.name: DM_ENG_Device_AddTransfer
methods.description: Adds a new transfer (download or upload) with parameters.

methods.name: DM_ENG_Device_RestartTransfer
methods.description: Restarts a transfer based on its data model path.

methods.name: handle_pending_upgrade
methods.description: Handles pending firmware upgrade transfer status.

methods.name: DM_ENG_Device_UpDownloadInitialize
methods.description: Initializes transfer states at system startup, handling ongoing, finished, or pending transfers.
